state_features.suggestion_scope: Unevaluated internal-node actions, shared with the deterministic control. You may modify, combine or replace them within the action-space contract. No native candidate scores or other policy results are available.

reference_routing_order.policy: Deterministic control ranks target fanin descending, source logical layer, Manhattan length descending, edge IDs; recomputed after a move. You may select a different complete order.

fixed_port_envelope.scope: Lower bound only, not a promise of routable area. Port phases are not fixed.

rules.port_coordinate_scope: PI/PO node XY are fixed; this does not pin phases or detailed terminal orientation.
rules.objective: Reduce actual routed bounding area and exported QCA cells; both non-increasing, one strictly improved. Distinguish node-box proxy from actual routed area.
rules.routing_execution: The supplied complete routing_order is executed once by A*, with no order fallback. A failed candidate consumes the evaluation and returns diagnostics.
rules.internal_optimization: Keep every input/output XY fixed; relocate only internal logical nodes. Logical layers describe dependency, not immutable physical rows. Permit X and Y changes, local reordering and coordinated connected-group moves. Preserve every logical node and edge. A smaller internal envelope or Manhattan sum is a proxy: accept only independently certified actual area/QCA Pareto gains.
